subject: chemistry
content: Igniting MnO<sub>2</sub> converts it quantitatively to Mn<sub>3</sub>O<sub>4</sub>. A sample of pyrolusite is of the following composition : MnO<sub>2</sub> 80%, SiO<sub>2</sub> and other inert constituents 15%, rest being water. The sample is ignited in air to constant weight. What is the percentage of Mn in the ignited sample? [O = 16, Mn = 54.9]
